subject: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novaclinic.com>, Jared Olsen <jared.olsen@novaclinic.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff

Hi Samira / Jared —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call recap
- Use case: secure patient-facing summarization for clinician workflows (PHI scope confirmed by product).
- Planned rollout: pilot with 50 users in Q3; production in Q4 pending compliance sign-off.

Requested items from you / next steps
1) SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) + any bridge letter we can share — this will unblock our security review.
2) Trust portal access for an account-level download of supporting evidence (preferred) — otherwise we’ll accept the redacted PDF.
3) Start the Vendor Security Questionnaire (I attached our VSQ template). Please confirm who on your team will own that (security reviewer + technical contact).

Timing: if you can share the SOC 2 and portal invite within 48 business hours that would keep our procurement timeline intact. If any items are HIPAA-scoped and require a BAA, flag that now.

Attachments:
- redwood_vsq_template.xlsx (Vendor Security Questionnaire template)

If you prefer, I can loop in our security lead (Aisha) directly to coordinate portal access and bridge letter redaction.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I hear back from you.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novaclinic.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the clear notes. We’ll move on this. A few quick items from our side: 
- I’m our security lead but I’ll hand off the VSQ to our security engineer (Jared copied). Jared will own the questionnaire.
- HIPAA: yes, some PHI is in scope for the pilot. We will need to confirm BAA terms; please advise if Redwood has a standard BAA or if legal wants a draft.
- Timeline: we should be able to share the SOC 2 redacted PDF within 48 hours; access to a portal would be ideal but likely will take one business day to approve.

Questions for you:
1) Do you accept a redacted SOC 2 PDF if certain artifact links are protected?
2) Can the bridge letter be redacted to remove customer-specific examples?

Thanks — Jared, can you confirm receipt and who will start the VSQ?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Security | Nova Clinic
samira.khan@novaclinic.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-20T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff

Aisha / Monica —

Forwarding the thread with Nova Clinic (deal RDW-2893). They confirmed HIPAA is in-scope for the pilot and would like the SOC 2 redacted PDF and a portal invite if possible. They also asked about a bridge letter and VSQ ownership (Jared will own questionnaire).

Request for security team:
- Please prepare: (a) redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF for sharing, (b) a one-page bridge letter template we can send to customers, and (c) initiate trust portal invite for account "Nova Clinic."
- If the SOC 2 includes any HIPAA-specific control mappings, call that out so we can expedite legal/BAA conversation.
- Timeline: customer hopes for SOC 2 within 48 hours; portal invite within one business day.

Attachments: attaching the VSQ template we sent in case you want to prefill any answers.

Thanks — any questions ping me.

Vivek
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff

Vivek —

Thanks for the ping. I’ve started the intake and here’s the plan / ETA: 

1) SOC 2 deliverable: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF (removing customer-specific PII from evidence attachments). I’ve attached a redacted summary (soc2_summary_redacted.pdf). ETA: within 24 business hours.

2) Bridge letter: I’ll prepare a short bridge letter draft for external sharing (attached: soc2_bridge_letter_draft.docx). Please confirm if Nova Clinic needs specific language re: HIPAA mapping — if so we’ll coordinate with our compliance attorney.

3) Trust portal access: I have created a temporary invite link for Nova Clinic. Please share the link with Samira (or I can send directly). Link (single-use, expires in 7 days): https://trust.redwoodinference.com/portal/novaclinic/invite?token=abc123

4) VSQ turnaround: we will review the attached redwood_vsq_template.xlsx and pre-fill the control owner names for the items that map to SOC 2. Jared can submit the VSQ on your side; if he wants us to own the majority of the answers and then get sign-off, we can do that to speed up review.

Notes on HIPAA: our SOC 2 scope includes control families that overlap with HIPAA admin/tech safeguards; however, a BAA is a separate legal document. Legal has a standard BAA template — happy to route it once you confirm you want to proceed.

Attachments included in this message:
- soc2_summary_redacted.pdf
- soc2_bridge_letter_draft.docx

I will also log this in the deal (HubSpot) under RDW-2893 and tag legal for BAA review. 

Thanks — I’ll send the redacted PDF and bridge letter later today.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Security intake, SOC 2 access, and VSQ kickoff

Samira / Jared —

Quick update: Aisha created a trust portal invite and will deliver the redacted SOC 2 and bridge letter today. Jared, feel free to start the VSQ — we can prefill controls where helpful. I’ll loop legal on the BAA after you confirm.

Expect the portal link (single-use) in a separate email from Aisha.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Vivek
